glosses: A cylindrical mechanical fastener that attaches multiple parts together by fitting through a hole and deforming the head(s) at either end.
Any fixed point or certain basis.
A light kind of footman's plate armour; an almain rivet.

examples.text: over his rivet he had a garment of white cloth of gold with a redde crosse

In 1579 it is mentioned that Almain rivets are now out of use, and in lieu of them a corselett shall be found. The rivets varied in cost; in 1509 they were to be had for 8s., in 1512 they were imported at 16s., and again in 1513 […]

glosses: To attach or fasten parts by using rivets.

examples.text: Terror riveted him to the spot.
